lessons.symptom: An early iOS share implementation built but did not import a real file shared from Files.
lessons.cause: The earlier gate had no end-to-end App Group and file-provider handoff check; the exact contribution of the initial plugin configuration and simulator entitlements was not isolated in a saved reproduction.
lessons.proposed_change: Add a real Files share smoke-check to the Flutter delivery checklist for apps with an iOS share extension: test both a suspended app and cold start, check content and cleanup.
lessons.regression_check: On an entitled iOS simulator, share two differently named documents, resume and cold-launch the app, verify new contents and an empty pending inbox.

lessons.symptom: Android debug build failed when receive_sharing_intent compiled Kotlin for JVM 21 while Java used 1.8.
lessons.cause: The plugin module's Java and Kotlin compile tasks had inconsistent JVM targets.
lessons.proposed_change: In the Flutter delivery reference, require an early Android debug build after adding a native plugin and inspect task-level JVM targets when Gradle reports compatibility failure.
lessons.regression_check: A build with mismatched Java/Kotlin targets fails, then passes after aligned targets without disabling target validation.
